subject: [PATCH 1/3] kernfs: activate a new node without dropping kernfs_rwsem

2026-09-13.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the kernfs kernel file system by reducing the number of write locks taken on a root directory when creating new nodes. It achieves this by calling the kernfs_activate_one function before dropping the lock, which only activates the newly created node without walking its children. This reduces the overhead of acquiring and releasing the write lock for every new node, resulting in improved performance. The patch also includes statistics showing a significant reduction in write lock acquisitions after applying the change.
